newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia share volume thins, prices slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Latvia share volume thins, prices slightly firmer.

text.p: Latvian share volume thinned on Friday to 52,522 lats from 196,819 while prices were mostly firmer, dealers said.
Saules Bank's index Saule10, which follows the 10 most liquid stocks, rose by 0.81 percent to 151.41.
On the main official list Riga Transport Fleet was the most traded on business of 14,118 lats and was unchanged at 1.67 lats.
Other secondary list stock, Staburadze confectionery, closed off three santimes to 2.57 lats on volume of 5,898 lats.
Usual market leader Unibanka overcame Thursday's weakness and regained four santimes to 3.24 lats turning over a small 4,866 lats.
On the secondary list activity in most shares fell, especially in the Daugavpils Chain maker.
Daugavpils registered trade of 3,600 lats against Thursday's 75,692 lats and gained four santimes to 2.25 lats.
Lode Brick factory saw shares worth 2,360 lats change hands and put on four santimes to 1.95 lats.
Prices of most fish canneries firmed.
Kaija edged up one santime as it traded 4,056 lats of shares and Salacgriva 95 advanced five santimes and gained in volume, registering 2,070.
Liepaja cannery was also among the day's few strong gainers as it added 10 santimes to 1.35 lats on volume of 658 lats.
The Roja Fish cannery registered activity worth 3,000 lats as it fell 10 santimes to 3.00 lats.
